name: Oklahoma
agency: Oklahoma Department of Public Safety, Oklahoma Highway Patrol Marine Enforcement Section

rule.hpNote: motor of more than 10 hp; also any PWC and sailboats 16 ft or longer
rule.textEn: Only operators aged 12 to 15 need it: a NASBLA-approved course for any boat with a motor over 10 hp, a sailboat 16 ft or longer, or a PWC, plus adult supervision.
rule.textEs: Solo lo necesitan quienes tienen de 12 a 15 años: un curso aprobado por NASBLA para cualquier embarcación con motor de más de 10 hp, un velero de 16 pies o más o una moto acuática, además de supervisión de un adulto.

minAge.note: Ages 12-15 with the card still need an adult 18+ on board (motorboat or sailboat) or watching within 500 yards (PWC).

exemptions: Boats with a motor of 10 hp or less (sailboats under 16 ft).

card.feeNote: The Highway Patrol 6-hour classroom course is free; private online and home-study providers usually charge.

pwcExtra: Youths 12-15 on a PWC must be watched by an adult 18+ within 500 yards.

sources.publisher: Oklahoma Department of Public Safety, Oklahoma Highway Patrol Marine Enforcement Section
sources.quote: Any person who is 12, 13, 14 or 15 years of age that operates any boat powered by a motor more than 10 horsepower, a sailboat 16 feet or greater in length or a personal watercraft (PWC) is required to successfully complete a boating safety education class.

sources.publisher: Oklahoma Department of Public Safety, Oklahoma Highway Patrol Marine Enforcement Section
sources.quote: You must successfully complete a National Association of State Boating Law Administrators (NASBLA) approved boating safety course. If you pass the course, a card will be issued to you.

sources.publisher: Oklahoma Department of Public Safety, Oklahoma Highway Patrol Marine Enforcement Section
sources.quote: If you are operating a motor boat or sailboat, you must have an adult 18 years of age or older on board the boat with you in a position to take control of the boat if necessary. If you are on a PWC, you must be visually supervised by an adult 18 years of age or older within 500 yards of where you are operating your PWC.

sources.publisher: Oklahoma Department of Public Safety, Oklahoma Highway Patrol Marine Enforcement Section
sources.quote: The Oklahoma Highway Patrol offers a free 6-hour classroom course.

sources.publisher: Oklahoma Department of Public Safety, Oklahoma Highway Patrol Marine Enforcement Section
sources.quote: There are private course providers that offer Internet and video home-study courses. Private course providers usually charge a fee to take their course.
